comparison.objective: Assemble and tighten a copper-pipe compression fitting.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered component assembly, pipe insertion, nut threading, and torque-limited spanner use.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe home, olive correctly under nut, nut 3/4–1 1/4 turns past snug, tool returned, hands clear and still; over-tightening zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests threaded fitting assembly and controlled tightening, not sieve manipulation.
